gates.name: Nothing new
gates.says: The parts exist. It is a matter of someone building it.

gates.name: Building at scale
gates.says: The science is known, and it has to be built far larger or far more often than anything so far.

gates.name: More capable AI
gates.says: Machines have to reason, plan or act well beyond what they do today.

gates.name: Rules, acceptance and cost
gates.says: It could be made now, and waits for the law, for people to want it, or for it to become cheap enough.

gates.name: New materials and new computing
gates.says: It waits for a material, or a kind of computer, that does not exist yet.

gates.name: A breakthrough in biology
gates.says: It waits for an understanding of the body or the brain that nobody has yet.

gates.name: A breakthrough in energy
gates.says: It waits for a source or a store of energy far beyond any in use.

made_by.method: One model named each node from the ideas the export places in it, judged how far along each is today, and drew the links between kinds of technology. The links were then compared with the order in which strategy games that model the future make their players research the same things, and changed where the games agreed with one another against the first draft.
made_by.reviewed_by: a separate reviewing run of the same model, which traced every link and confirmed that the whole board can be reached. No person reviewed each link
